title: Unforgeable evidence — gate on signed evidence an agent cannot produce without the human

acceptance_criteria.given: a trust ref with attestation.enforce true, evidence.require_signature.attestation true, and a security-key signer in its evidence.allowed_signers file
acceptance_criteria.when: the merge gate reads a current attestation whose line-2 hash a current bundle names, and the bundle's line 3 is a valid signature by that signer, with the user-presence flag set, over a bundle payload scoped to this repository, pull request and head

tests.name: verifies an attestation named by a bundle that a trust-ref allowed signer signed

acceptance_criteria.given: a trust ref with attestation.enforce true and evidence.require_signature.attestation true
acceptance_criteria.when: no current bundle names the line-2 hash of any current trusted attestation, and, in a second case, the only current bundle that names it carries a line 3 that does not verify
acceptance_criteria.then: the first case gives the attestation state explicit with the warning EVIDENCE_UNSIGNED, and the second case gives the state failed with EVIDENCE_SIGNATURE_INVALID; neither gives verified

tests.name: routes an unsigned attestation to explicit when signatures are required
fails an attestation whose bundle signature does not verify

acceptance_criteria.given: a trust ref with evidence.require_signature.criteria true and signer A, and a pull request whose head adds key B to the signers file and carries a trust-root comment for that change, named by a bundle that A signed
acceptance_criteria.when: the merge gate verifies criteria evidence named by a bundle that key B signed
acceptance_criteria.then: the criteria evidence blocks with EVIDENCE_SIGNER_UNKNOWN, because signers are read from the trust ref and a new signer counts only after it merges

tests.name: reads allowed signers from the trust ref, never the head

acceptance_criteria.given: a trust ref that requires attestation signatures, a bundle that a trust-ref signer validly signed for another repository, another pull request, or another head SHA, and a verified bundle for this head that names a criteria payload line
acceptance_criteria.when: in separate cases, the other bundle and the attestation that it names are posted on this pull request with line 1 of each rewritten to the marker for the current head, the named criteria payload line is posted under the attestation marker for the current head, and an other-head attestation is posted with line 1 unchanged
acceptance_criteria.then: each rewritten or moved comment blocks with EVIDENCE_SIGNATURE_SCOPE, and the unchanged other-head attestation blocks with ATTESTATION_STALE, so no replay is believed

tests.name: refuses a bundle replayed from another repository, pull request, or head, and a payload moved to another family

acceptance_criteria.given: a trust ref with no evidence block, or with evidence.require_signature.attestation false
acceptance_criteria.when: the gate reads an attestation that no current bundle names, an attestation that a verified bundle names, or an attestation named by a bundle that fails verification for any reason, including a missing signers file or no usable ssh-keygen
acceptance_criteria.then: the first gives output byte-identical to the gate before this spec, the second is accepted, and the third is judged as unsigned with a warning that carries the EVIDENCE_* code

tests.name: accepts unsigned and validly signed evidence while signatures are not required
warns on a failing signature while signatures are not required

acceptance_criteria.given: a trust ref with evidence.require_signature.criteria true and evidence.require_signature.review true, and a pull request whose linked specs declare active criteria
acceptance_criteria.when: the merge gate reads criteria evidence that no current bundle names, and pr-stack entry reads a review-complete comment that no current bundle names
acceptance_criteria.then: the criteria evidence blocks with EVIDENCE_UNSIGNED, and pr-stack entry reports reviewedAtHead false and does not skip the review stage

tests.name: requires a signature on criteria evidence
does not skip the review stage on unsigned review-complete evidence

acceptance_criteria.given: a configured evidence key that is a plain private key file readable by the current user and is not a security-key (sk) key
acceptance_criteria.then: doctor warns EVIDENCE_KEY_AGENT_READABLE, because a signature from that key proves nothing about who signed

tests.name: warns when the signing key is readable by the agent's user

acceptance_criteria.given: the parsed YAML of .github/workflows/test.yml and of plugins/dotbabel/templates/workflows/test.yml
acceptance_criteria.when: the test reads the classify job of each file
acceptance_criteria.then: no step of the classify job checks out the head or the merge ref, the verifier runs from a checkout of the trust ref, and the only step that writes the attested output sets it from the exit status of the dotbabel evidence verifier

tests.name: the template classify job skips only on a signature the trust-ref verifier accepts
this repository's classify job skips only on a signature the trust-ref verifier accepts

acceptance_criteria.given: a trust ref whose signers file holds at least one evidence signer, with attestation.enforce true or false
acceptance_criteria.when: the merge gate judges a pull request that changes the signers file or the evidence block of .dotbabel.json, with no trust-root comment, and again with a trust-root comment over exactly that change, named by a bundle that a trust-ref signer signed
acceptance_criteria.then: the first case blocks with EVIDENCE_TRUST_ROOT_UNSIGNED, and the second case reports no trust-root reason

tests.name: blocks a trust-root change that no trust-ref signer signed
accepts a trust-root change signed over exactly that change

acceptance_criteria.given: a trust ref that requires attestation signatures and declares no unattended principals and no signer tiers
acceptance_criteria.when: the shared verifier checks a bundle signed by a security key whose SSHSIG flags lack user presence, and a bundle signed by a non-sk key
acceptance_criteria.then: the verifier returns EVIDENCE_NO_USER_PRESENCE for both bundles, even though ssh-keygen accepts each signature

tests.name: refuses a signature made without user presence

acceptance_criteria.given: a stacked pull request whose base is a feature branch that adds key K to the signers file and sets evidence.require_signature.attestation false, over a default branch that requires attestation signatures and does not list K, with attestation.enforce true on both branches
acceptance_criteria.when: the merge gate and pr-stack entry judge the child pull request with an attestation named by a bundle that K signed
acceptance_criteria.then: both read the policy and the signers from the default branch, the merge gate blocks with EVIDENCE_SIGNER_UNKNOWN, and pr-stack entry reports attestedAtHead false

tests.name: reads the evidence policy and signers from the default branch for a stacked pull request

acceptance_criteria.given: a trust ref that requires attestation signatures, and a pull request whose review-complete comment for its head a verified bundle names
acceptance_criteria.when: pr-stack entry reads a trusted, current, passing attestation that no current bundle names
acceptance_criteria.then: hasCurrentAttestation returns false, attestedAtHead is false, and the entry phase is local-attest, not a stop with REVIEWED_AND_ATTESTED

tests.name: pr-stack entry does not count an unsigned attestation when signatures are required

acceptance_criteria.when: the attestation gather reads the base ref, the evidence gather reads the trust ref, and the verifier checks a bundle signature
acceptance_criteria.then: every git argv starts with git --no-replace-objects, the environment that the real runner passes has no GIT_DIR, GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY, GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES or GIT_REPLACE_REF_BASE, and every ssh-keygen argv starts with an absolute path

tests.name: runs git without replace refs or redirected object stores, and ssh-keygen by absolute path

acceptance_criteria.given: a trust ref signers file whose only line for key K has no namespaces option
acceptance_criteria.when: the shared verifier checks a bundle that K signed
acceptance_criteria.then: the verifier ignores that line and returns EVIDENCE_SIGNER_UNKNOWN

tests.name: ignores a signers line that does not pin the evidence namespace

acceptance_criteria.given: a trust ref signers file with an undeclared non-sk key that ssh-add -L lists, a line without the evidence namespace, and an evidence key that is also the git user.signingkey
acceptance_criteria.then: doctor warns EVIDENCE_KEY_IN_AGENT, EVIDENCE_SIGNER_NO_NAMESPACE and EVIDENCE_KEY_SHARED, one finding for each signer line or key it names

tests.name: checks every signer line and every key the ssh agent holds

acceptance_criteria.given: a base ref with attestation.enforce true whose governance_files list names .github/workflows/test.yml, as this repository's .dotbabel.json does after PR-3
acceptance_criteria.when: the merge gate judges a pull request that edits the classify step of that workflow
acceptance_criteria.then: the attestation state is explicit and the ATTESTATION_GOVERNED_CHANGE warning names .github/workflows/test.yml

tests.name: routes a pull request that edits the classify step to explicit
this repository governs its test workflow

acceptance_criteria.given: a trust ref that requires attestation signatures, and a verified bundle for the head that names the line-2 hash of attestation comment A
acceptance_criteria.when: the merge gate judges the pull request while the only current attestation is a re-post of A whose line 2 differs, and again after a second verified bundle names the re-post
acceptance_criteria.then: the first judgment gives the attestation state explicit with the warning EVIDENCE_UNSIGNED, and the second gives verified

tests.name: treats a family comment re-posted after the bundle as unsigned until a new bundle names it

acceptance_criteria.given: a trust ref whose evidence.signer_tiers declares the fingerprint of non-sk key K with tier approval-agent, and whose signers file has kept lines for K and for non-sk key L, which has no declaration
acceptance_criteria.when: the shared verifier checks a bundle that K signed and a bundle that L signed
acceptance_criteria.then: the K bundle verifies with the tier approval-agent in the result, and the L bundle gives EVIDENCE_NO_USER_PRESENCE

tests.name: accepts a declared approval-agent signer and names its tier

acceptance_criteria.given: a trust ref whose evidence.signer_tiers declares non-sk key K with tier approval-agent, and an ssh agent whose ssh-add -L lists K
acceptance_criteria.then: doctor does not warn EVIDENCE_KEY_IN_AGENT for K, and it warns EVIDENCE_SIGNER_APPROVAL_AGENT for K

tests.name: reports a declared approval-agent signer as a weaker tier, not as a key in the agent
